A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ComFe and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary material. Retained content can be matched despite the changed title and appendix organization.

before.justification: v4 reports original ComFe classification, robustness, OOD detection, and ablation results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains original classification and ablation results and adds FunnyBirds interpretability measurements, alternative-backbone experiments, and diagnostic case studies.

M1.justification: The frozen-backbone classifier, prototype hierarchy, losses, and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. v5 removes the auxiliary pmax(y,P) scoring procedure proposed for OOD detection and prediction reliability in v4 Appendix B.

E1.justification: v5 adds FunnyBirds, introducing synthetic birds with known parts for interpretability evaluation. It removes the OOD detection task and its dedicated datasets, including ImageNet-O and the OpenOOD suite. The original nine classification datasets and ImageNet classification robustness tests remain.

E2.justification: The comparators in Tables 1–4 are retained, but v4 Table S7's OOD comparison against KNN+, Energy, and NN-Guide disappears. v5 adds a separate FunnyBirds comparison with ProtoPNet and qualitative comparisons using reproduced PIP-Net and ProtoPFormer explanations in Figure S6.

E3.justification: v5 introduces FunnyBirds evaluation using accuracy and five interpretability measures, plus CUB200 comparisons across six frozen ViT-B backbone variants in Table S8. OOD AUROC and confidence-versus-accuracy evaluation protocols are removed. Existing classification and ablation settings are retained.

E4.justification: v5 adds quantitative interpretability testing, alternative-backbone analyses, mislabeled-exemplar case studies, and a red-wing-patch removal example. The reliability analysis in v4 Figure S8 is removed. Existing background-prototype, register, seed, and hyperparameter analyses are retained under revised appendix organization.

E5.justification: Both versions report five-run means and standard deviations for the same ablations and retain the same four-seed Food-101 and Oxford Pets examples. The new experiments add point estimates without introducing additional statistical uncertainty reporting or stated increases in run counts.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 and matched ablation results retain their values. v5 adds FunnyBirds measurements, including completeness of 0.01 for ViT-B/14 and 0.86 for its register variant, alternative-backbone CUB200 scores, and new qualitative findings. v4's OOD AUROCs and reliability findings are removed.

T1.justification: The formal pmax(y,P) definition in v4 Equation 37 is removed. The classifier's mixture formulation, Bayes derivations, auxiliary losses, and label-smoothing construction remain mathematically equivalent; the revised von Mises–Fisher notation and equation numbering do not establish new theory.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction add the novelty claim that ComFe is the first interpretable classification head, alongside the retained ImageNet scalability claim. Core claims about competitive accuracy, robustness, efficiency, and prototype-based explanations remain substantially unchanged.

C2.justification: v5 explicitly qualifies comparisons involving different backbones and FunnyBirds interfaces. It proposes label noise as an explanation for CUB200 underperformance and extends existing context-leakage discussions with quantitative completeness failures and alternative-backbone behavior. OOD and reliability interpretations are removed.

D1.justification: v5 newly identifies the DINOv2 ViT-S/14 backbone for the retained faithfulness examples and documents pretraining regimes for the alternative backbones in Table S8. Core training and hardware details remain unchanged. The printed repository URL has the same destination as v4's GitHub hyperlink.

R1.justification: v5 adds the FunnyBirds and AugReg references, removes references supporting the OOD section, and strengthens positioning as an interpretable head for frozen backbones. The central ProtoP, INTR, and self-supervised-learning related-work discussion remains largely intact.

P1.justification: v5 retitles the paper, rewrites important framing and comparison passages, removes the standalone Discussion section, and reorganizes the main ending around interpretability evaluation. The supplement separates prototype visualization into Appendix B and restructures additional results and ablations into Appendices C–D.

P2.justification: v5 adds interpretability and alternative-backbone tables and several case-study figures, while removing the OOD table and reliability figure. It relocates v4 Figure 4 to Figure S7 and Table S8 to Table S14, compresses Tables 3–4 into single columns, and substantially rearranges appendix displays.

improvement.justification: v5 strengthens the existing interpretability evidence with FunnyBirds measurements, diagnostic exemplars, broader backbone checks, and clearer comparison limitations. These additions support the paper's central purpose, although the synthetic, imperfectly matched comparisons remain limited and the OOD/reliability evidence is lost.
